findings.documented: Every request carries api_key as a query parameter.
findings.actual: Protected requests reject api_key in the query string and require the key in the X-API-Key request header.
findings.how_found: Called protected endpoints with api_key as a query parameter and reproduced the 401 error instructing the client to send X-API-Key instead; repeated the requests successfully with the header.
findings.impact: Clients following the documentation cannot access protected endpoints.

findings.documented: Login returns a token valid for 86400 seconds and there is no refresh flow.
findings.actual: Login returns access_token and refresh_token, expires_in is 900 seconds, and /auth/refresh is provided for session renewal.
findings.how_found: Logged in with a demo account and inspected the real response; also reproduced an expired-token response and successfully renewed the session through /auth/refresh.
findings.impact: A client built for the documented 24-hour token lifetime will stop working after about 15 minutes unless it implements refresh.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings only; inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side.
findings.actual: The retrievable dataset contains both live and non-live records: 3722 of 4700 records have is_live true.
findings.how_found: Paged the endpoint to the end and counted is_live values in every retrievable record.
findings.impact: The UI must explicitly handle inactive records rather than assuming every returned listing is active.

findings.documented: Every listing_id is globally unique, and each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: 4700 listing records describe 4380 distinct physical properties; multiple records can describe the same physical property.
findings.how_found: Grouped records using stable physical-property location fields and inspected repeated coordinate/property groups.
findings.impact: Record counts overstate the number of distinct properties and duplicate records must be accounted for in analysis.

findings.documented: A single listing is available at /v1/listing/{listing_id}.
findings.actual: The documented path returns 404 Not Found.
findings.impact: Listing detail pages cannot be implemented using the documented path.

findings.documented: The documentation does not list /v1/listings/{id} as the single-listing endpoint.
findings.how_found: Probed candidate detail routes after the documented singular route returned 404 and verified the plural route returned the listing.
findings.impact: This is the working route required for URL-based listing detail pages.

findings.documented: GET and POST /v1/favourites and DELETE /v1/favourites/{id} provide saved-listing functionality.
findings.actual: The documented favourites routes return 404 Not Found.
findings.how_found: Requested the documented favourites routes directly while authenticated.
findings.impact: The documented saved-listing implementation cannot work.

findings.actual: GET /v1/saved lists saved listings, POST /v1/saved with listing_id saves a listing, and DELETE /v1/saved/{id} removes it.
findings.how_found: Probed plausible saved-listing routes and verified the working route with a real demo account.
findings.impact: This undocumented route family is required to implement persistent per-user saved listings.

findings.documented: Provides pre-computed aggregates for the city.
findings.actual: The documented endpoint returns 404 Not Found.
findings.how_found: Requested the documented path while authenticated.
findings.impact: The insights screen must calculate aggregates from the available collection endpoints instead.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are integer rupee values everywhere.
findings.actual: Observed project price values use compact real-estate units rather than raw rupee integers; the values require unit interpretation to represent realistic INR prices.
findings.how_found: Compared project price scales against listing price scales and inspected representative project records.
findings.impact: Displaying project price values as literal rupees produces nonsensical prices and incorrect project comparisons.

findings.documented: total_listings is recomputed and always agrees with the number of listings available for the project.
findings.actual: 392 projects have a reported total_listings value different from the count of retrievable listing records carrying that project_id.
findings.how_found: Paged all listings and projects, grouped listings by project_id, and compared each count with the project's total_listings.
findings.impact: Project availability counts cannot be trusted without independent verification.

findings.documented: Returned listing data is safe to show and the reference describes normal property records.
findings.actual: 24 records contain impossible values such as non-positive prices, floor numbers above total_floors, or carpet area greater than super built-up area.
findings.how_found: Ran invariant checks across every retrievable listing record.
findings.impact: These records distort aggregates and must be excluded from calculations such as price per square foot.

findings.actual: Eight listings use implausibly tiny sale prices for otherwise normal Bangalore residential properties and appear to exist to generate enquiries rather than represent genuine sale offers.
findings.how_found: Sorted sale prices across the complete dataset and inspected extreme low-price outliers relative to property type, bedroom count and area.
findings.impact: These records materially distort price analytics and should be excluded from market calculations.

findings.documented: Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC with a Z suffix everywhere in the API.
findings.actual: Listing posted_at values are returned without a timezone suffix or explicit UTC offset, while rental timestamps include Z.
findings.how_found: Compared posted_at formats across the complete listings and rentals datasets.
findings.impact: Clients cannot blindly apply the documented universal UTC/Z convention and must interpret listing timestamps carefully for time-window calculations.
